name: plan-on-md
problem: The plan becomes a folder of markdown records with lifecycle in state.json: same reads, mint/rm/lifecycle verbs, prose edited in place, legacy plan.json readable forever

architecture_summary.role: loads folder plans, mints records, pre-flights removals
the trimmed plan verb surface: mint, rm, lifecycle, untouched reads
carries the rewritten briefing to every project

scenarios: A plan authors end-to-end in the record form: use mints the folder, task add mints seeded files, the author fills prose and ownership, verify comes clean, start/next/close walk the waves. Runs on cargo test (plan_e2e).
The legacy plan.json driving this very migration keeps advancing: its lifecycle verbs work untouched through the dual read. Runs on cargo test (plan_e2e legacy case).

tasks.description: The storage and mint layer — additive, the tree keeps compiling. Folder form under archi/plans/<name>/: charter <name>.md (problem prose; Stack/Architecture sections as bullets), one t<N>-<node-slug>.md per task (frontmatter: node, owns inline list; sections: desc prose, Spec/Inputs/Outputs/Stack bullets, Verifications keyed by owned slug), scenarios.md (bullets), state.json (state, closed_waves, version, version_hash, created — serde, shape-validated on load, unknown fields refuse). load_plan reads folder or legacy plan.json into the existing Plan struct unchanged (legacy read-only forever); both forms at once is a load error naming the choice; duplicate task ids across files is a load error naming both. save paths route by form: folder plans persist state via state.json alone, legacy keeps writing plan.json. Mint layer: use_plan mints the folder (idempotent on byte-equal skeletons), task_add mints a seeded task file (spec_refs from the node as today), task_rm pre-flights: inputs of other tasks naming it, or state past draft, refuse with the list. Old authoring functions stay compiling untouched — t2 deletes them with their dispatch. Unit tests cover the new layer; plan_e2e gains the record round-trip, legacy and both-forms cases.

a-plan-is-a-folder-of-records: cargo test plan_e2e — a record plan round-trips: mint, fill files, verify clean, start/next/close walk the waves
cargo test plan_e2e — a legacy plan.json loads read-only and its lifecycle verbs still advance it
cargo test plan_e2e — plan.json beside the folder refuses loudly naming the choice; duplicate task ids across files refuse naming both

tasks.description: The surface trim, one cut with the dispatch. plans/mod.rs: delete the prose-transport authoring functions (set_problem, tech_add, summary_add, mapping_add, scenarios_add/remove, task_desc, stack_detail_add, input_add, output_add, spec_ref_add, own_add/remove, verification_add/remove) — folder plans never call them, legacy is read-only. main.rs: dispatch arms and USAGE drop the dead verbs; plan use/task add wire to the mints, plan task rm lands with its refusal texts; guarded_route keeps use/task add/task rm/lifecycle as mutations, every read stays free; batch inherits the surface. verify holds owns outside the matched set as the error gating start. plan_e2e and batch tests rewrite their authoring flow as file edits between mints.

inputs.t1: the new plans API surface: load/mint/rm signatures and what died

plan-records-mint-by-verb: cargo test plan_e2e — task add mints a seeded skeleton, an identical re-mint converges, an edited file refuses
cargo test plan_e2e — task rm refuses while another task's inputs name it and outside draft, with the list
cargo test plan_e2e — a hand-typed owns outside the matched set fails verify and start refuses on it
